attribution_precondition: client opens fresh connections per measurement; connections are not shared between operations
byte_layer: IP total lengths, not captured snapshot lengths or physical Ethernet wire bytes
capture_counter_difference_meaning: absolute received/captured discrepancy; unresolved startup filtering or unread buffers may explain it; not a count of proven lost transfer packets
capture_lifecycle_scope: bounded ready, preflight and post-client quiet observations, clean interrupt/reap and independently emitted final statistics; does not prove network drain or coverage outside the capture interval
completeness_scope: parsed selected-flow records have unambiguous observed-SYN ownership; every measurement has packets and published body-byte coverage; tcpdump captured and received counters equal the PCAP record count with zero reported kernel drops; offload state, filter installation, interface drops and traffic beyond the capture interval require separate provenance
excludes: traffic outside the isolated fixture and capture interval
includes: captured synthetic TCP payload, ACKs and retransmissions
partition_rule: outbound SYN assigns a TCP four-tuple to the containing inclusive measurement interval, or setup before the first row; all subsequent connection packets retain that owner through PCAP EOF; missing SYN, changed initial sequence, and SYN outside active intervals are unattributed
qualification_traffic: synthetic plaintext TCP; no WAN or TLS claim
